posts.subject: Applying for a Test Admin /Knife server
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello i would love to be an admin on your server, this way i can help people and make sure everyone is following the rules
[I don't fill all the requirements]
1) Name?= My in-game name is SvetlinDaBoss, my real name is Svetlin
2) Age?= i am 14 birthday is on September
3) Why do you want to join our Administrative team?= I love the knife server i have only tried that one and i feel like there is a lack of admins, mostly not active. So people that play sometimes don't follow the rules and i think that someone should do something about it.
4) How long have you been playing our servers?= I've played for about almost a week but i am planning to play even longer.
5) What are your favorite hobbies or pastimes?= i like to watch pro's games on cs-go, i also love playing csgo i am very active played about 90 hours this week.
6)Do you think yourself as mature?= Yes i feel like i am mature enough i have friends that are a bit older than me we speak maturely, sensible.
7)Have you gained experience as an administrator before?= Yes i have a while ago in a css server but unfortunately my account was hacked and i cant get back on it so i made this one.
8)When do you play? (timetable of your average week?)= on your server from about 4-7 hours a day sometimes a lot more i am very active. Weekly its about 60-80 hours.
9) User 1 calls user 2 a "cunt" and proceeds to insult him further - what actions would you take?)= I would politely warn user 1 to stop. if user 1 doesn't stop then i would kick, if user 1 joins again and continues insulting i would ban for 1 Hour, After the hour if user 1 continues i would speak to an admin about it and see if the user can get a perm ban, its not appropriate.
10) Strengths:
Talking with people
Helping people
11) Weaknesses:
Speaking German i don't speak German i speak fluent English and Bulgarian
12) Conclusion / Closing remark - I just really would like to be an admin on your servers and help. I hope you will accept me
